title: Utility Functions Generator
description: Generate TypeScript utility functions and helper methods in src/lib/utils/ with TypeScript support and export configuration.

name.description: Name of the utility functions file (e.g., formatters, validators, helpers). Uses camelCase naming conventions.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this utility file?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where utilities are created (default: 'lib' creates src/lib/utils/)

projectName.description: Target project name where utility will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for utility creation

file.description: Optional: Create or append utility to existing file instead of creating separate file

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)
